id: \bPaul: So you're my tag partner. You still want to do this?
en: \bPaul: So you're my tag partner. You still want to do this?
it: \bPaul: Quindi sei tu il mio compagno di squadra. Vuoi ancora farlo?

id: \bHmph. Just don't get in my way.
en: \bHmph. Just don't get in my way.

it: \PN ha fatto squadra con Paul!\me[Item get]\wtnp[40]

id: \bPaul: Are you ready to keep going?
en: \bPaul: Are you ready to keep going?

id: \bIt will be hard to calculate the battles with an unworthy partner.
en: \bIt will be hard to calculate the battles with an unworthy partner.
it: \bSarà difficile calcolare le lotte con un compagno indegno.

id: \bI'm pumped. I can't wait to win.
en: \bI'm pumped. I can't wait to win.
it: \bSono carichissimo. Non vedo l'ora di vincere.

id: \bI need to plan ahead. It's hard without knowing much about my partner though.
en: \bI need to plan ahead. It's hard without knowing much about my partner though.
it: \bDevo pianificare in anticipo. Però è difficile senza sapere molto del mio compagno.

id: \rHello. Here you can register for the tournament.
en: \rHello. Here you can register for the tournament.

id: \rIf you register you will be assigned to a Trainer for Tag Battles. Would you like to register?
en: \rIf you register you will be assigned to a Trainer for Tag Battles. Would you like to register?
it: \rSe ti iscrivi, ti verrà assegnato un Allenatore con cui affrontare le Lotte in Coppia. Vuoi iscriverti?

id: \rGreat! Let's set you up for a battle.
en: \rGreat! Let's set you up for a battle.

id: \rAlright your first battle will be ready when you find your partner. His name is Paul.
en: \rAlright your first battle will be ready when you find your partner. His name is Paul.
it: \rBene, la tua prima lotta sarà pronta quando avrai trovato il tuo compagno. Si chiama Paul.
\rL'evento delle Lotte in Coppia è terminato.

id: \bThis is the battle field. You are not registered though.
en: \bThis is the battle field. You are not registered though.
it: \bQuesto è il campo di lotta. Però non sei iscritto.

id: \bThis is the battle field. Please find your partner.
en: \bThis is the battle field. Please find your partner.
it: \bQuesto è il campo di lotta. Trova il tuo compagno, per favore.
\bTi serve il tuo compagno per lottare.
\bL'evento delle Lotte in Coppia è terminato.

id: \bBrock: I hope I get matched with a cute girl.
en: \bBrock: I hope I get matched with a cute girl.
it: \bBrock: Spero di finire in coppia con una ragazza carina.

id: \rOh, good! You and your Pokémon are looking great. Take care now!
en: \rOh, good! You and your Pokémon are looking great.  Take care now!
it: \rOh, bene! Tu e i tuoi Pokémon avete un ottimo aspetto. Abbi cura di te!

id: \rMy partner better take this seriously. I aim to win.
en: \rMy partner better take this seriously. I aim to win.
it: \rSarà meglio che il mio compagno faccia sul serio. Io punto a vincere.
